2500: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Keep your chest on the pad.
2509: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.
2511: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.
2515: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
2523: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
2525: Step onto the vibrating plate with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your posture tall and your core braced.
Keep your weight balanced over your feet.
2526: Place your forearms or hands on the vibrating plate.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
2527: Place one foot on the vibrating plate and step the other back.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
2544: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Move gently and keep your neck neutral.
2555: Lie on your back with a loop band around your thighs.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
2560: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Push through your heels to stand.
2561: Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
2562: Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
2563: Attach a rope or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the rope with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the sled toward you with a rowing motion.
2564: Place your hands on a medicine ball in a plank.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
2566: Lie back on a bench or the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock that angle.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head in a slow arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pull the weight back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back from arching.
2567: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
2569: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.
2570: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.
2571: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2572: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.
2589: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
